_comment: Mood presets for prosody control. Applied to sections of entries based on content.

cozy.description: Warm bedtime story pace. Slow, gentle, makes you want to close your eyes.

tense.description: Something's wrong. Used for bug discoveries, production incidents.

urgent.description: Crisis mode. Used for disk full, 500 errors, deploy failures.

triumphant.description: We fixed it. Used for resolution moments.

reflective.description: Looking back. Used for lessons learned, closing paragraphs.

matter-of-fact.description: Neutral delivery. Used for technical explanations.

dramatic.description: Building tension. Used for reveals and 'But Wait' moments.

section_hints._comment: Hints for the SSML generator to auto-assign moods based on heading text or content patterns.
